protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: with mkhomedir enabled, _pam_create_homedir returns PAM_SUCCESS for an already-existing directory and _pam_mkhomedir then calls _pam_chown_homedir on the account's pw_dir; for an account whose pw_dir is '/', this reowns the filesystem root and causes availability failures. CVE-2026-15779 is PUBLISHED and the Red Hat CNA and GHSA descriptions match this mechanism.
